title: Anisotropic noise on a product basis function
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set with probability mass function $\pi$, and let $B$ be a finite Fourier basis on $\Omega$ indexed by a finite nonempty set $\iota$, with distinguished constant basis index $0_B$. Choose coordinate parameters $\rho_i\in[0,1]$ for $i=1,\ldots,n$, a point $x\in\Omega^n$, and a multi-index $a\in\iota^n$. The expectation of the product basis function indexed by $a$ under the coordinatewise noise distribution at $x$ is $\left(\prod_{i=1}^n c_i\right)\prod_{i=1}^n B_{a_i}(x_i)$, where $c_i=1$ if $a_i=0_B$ and $c_i=\rho_i$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
$B$ is a finite Fourier basis indexed by a finite nonempty set
